comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a Food Truck ordering system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes online orders before customers reach the truck: customers choose food and a collection time, pay online or pay when they collect, and the order then appears in your kitchen. A POS system or card machine takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe’s fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract period?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract period and no need to give notice. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance and you can still use it until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with locations that keep changing?
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up a weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and the day you are there.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen taking more orders than it can handle?
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can really make. The system calculates from each dish’s prep time and how many you can prepare per batch.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS system with a TSE?
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS system and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your POS system is something to ask your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
